Name: Pokemon Dolls
Author: meme12345bunny
Description:
[img]https://78.media.tumblr.com/78a94ac9d08bb1708274cea31666550e/tumblr_p9gbo9guZV1we6z1vo1_540.png[/img]﻿
This mod adds purchasable Pokemon Dolls from the Generation 4 games into Robin's shop as well as the Furniture Catalogue. Each plush comes in a different class: Non Jumbo which takes one space, Jumbo are more expensive plushies, and Super Jumbo plushies take 4 spaces.

This is my first mod, so any criticisms are greatly appreciated to improve this mod as well as any other mod I release in the future.

[img]https://78.media.tumblr.com/f12f52898f305efdc3cbab0fcc197aba/tumblr_p9gbo9guZV1we6z1vo2_540.png[/img]﻿

This mod requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1254/]CustomFurniture[/url]﻿.

Download and extract the folder. Then go to Steam > steamapps > common > Stardew Valley > Mods > CustomFurniture > Furniture and drop the folder in there.
